notes: Product list taken from the official sitemap (https://www.manulife.com.sg/sitemap.xml) under /en/solutions/ and cross-checked against the Life, Health, Save, Invest and Signature menu pages; every product page returned HTTP 200 to fetch_page-style requests.
Manulife returned 200 (not 403) to scripted requests that send a browser User-Agent plus an Accept-Language header; WebFetch alone got 403, so url_status is ok for all products.
Brochure PDFs sit behind '-brochure.html' lead-form pages in the sitemap but the English PDF links on those pages download directly; only English PDFs were kept.
The Health menu lists only Critical Illness (3 plans), Maternity (1) and Accident (1). No hospital or disability income plan is listed there.

Signature plans (Legacy Growth, Legacy Harvest, Heirloom, Signature Life Series and Elite/Prestige, Indexed Universal Life Select, Signature Wealth, income plans) target legacy planning and are largely US$-denominated; Signature Life Series, Signature Income Series, Signature Lifetime Rewards (II) (SGD) and Signature Wealth also offer SGD.

Category calls on ambiguous plans are explained in subtype: Manulife Indexed Wealth and WealthGen are filed as whole_life; RetireReady Plus (III), Manulife Indexed Income, Signature Income Series, Signature Lifetime Rewards (II) and Signature Indexed Income as annuity (lifetime income); IncomeGen (II) and IncomeSecure as endowment (savings with income); Signature Wealth (variable universal life) as ilp.
The Signature Income Series brochure on the site is dated 13 Dec 2021 and the DIRECT-ManuAssure pages carry a footer dated 2020; the pages remain live and listed.
Manulife Goal 2026 (I) is a 2-year single premium endowment named for its 2026 edition; check whether a newer edition replaces it.
Skipped pages: Manulife MOVE wellness, insights, campaigns, self-serve and the '-brochure' lead-form pages. Duplicate brochure page 'signature-life-brochure1.html' ignored.

Channel left as unknown except the two DIRECT-ManuAssure plans (direct purchase online); pages mention Manulife Financial Consultants and DBS/POSB branches as sales routes in footers but do not state a channel per product.
